messages:
Mike (CS): mirage-labs reporting repeated 429s overnight and high tail latency during their campaign warmup window. They say baseline qps ~120rps -> spikes to 900rps for ~8m which causes auth queueing + throttles. Attaching their summary and a short repro.

Alex W: thanks — can you paste the error sample and the pool id?

Mike (CS): pool: mirage-prod-dedicated-7. Errors: 429 body: "RequestRateTooLarge" ~4.7% of requests during spike. 95/99 latencies jump from 70ms -> 1.3s. Auth failures (401) also show ~0.3% concurrently.

Mike (CS): repro steps from customer: run steady traffic at 100rps for 45m, then blast 900rps for 8m without warmup. They use SDK with exponential backoff disabled on purpose for raw failure visibility.

Tara P: sounds like warmup headroom + autoscale lag. What's their pool target utilization and burst policy?

Mike (CS): customer expected 70% utilization target. Their reserved slab is 8 GPUs (g5x8), but autoscale min=2, max=12, scale cooldown 180s. They assumed rapid scale to 12 during bursts.

Priya (Eng Runtime): quick notes: autoscaler picks signal from node queue depth and token-serving backlog. Cold-starts + model load (llama2-13b-fp16) is ~22s on that infra. If they jump 9x in QPS, we hit kernel saturation and auth queue backs up.

SRE Lead: can we see the scaling timeline and deploy logs for that pool from 2246123200 - 2246125200 window? OpsBot: logs attached: 

OpsBot: ```
2024-11-02T03:40:12Z pool=mirage-prod-dedicated-7 qps=105
2024-11-02T03:48:10Z qps=912 -> autoscale: decision=min_nodes->6
2024-11-02T03:48:30Z model-load-start node=6 id=x-az-3
2024-11-02T03:48:52Z model-load-complete node=6
2024-11-02T03:49:12Z observed throttles=312 429s
2024-11-02T03:50:00Z qps=880 -> autoscale: add_nodes->10
2024-11-02T03:50:25Z observed 95p latency=1.1s
2024-11-02T03:55:10Z qps back to 140
```

Alex W: autoscaler decision seems conservative (6 nodes at first). Why didn't it jump faster? Is cooldown or prediction model preventing larger immediate scaling?

Priya (Eng Runtime): cooldown 180s + gradual add policy to avoid noisy neighbor churn. Also we try to avoid overshooting when bursts are short. But their burst sustained 8m which should have triggered more aggressive steps. Looks like a config mismatch: reserved slab g5x8 with max_nodes=12 but cpu/gpu provisioning limits per-az slowed node detachment; scheduler pacing made the step 2->6->10.

Tara P: mitigation options for customer: 1) increase reserved headroom (higher min nodes) 2) pre-warm nodes before campaign (API to pin nodes) 3) reduce model load time via checkpoint quantization/compile 4) adjust autoscale policy for faster ramp.

Mike (CS): customer asked for recommended numbers. Their steady qps 100, peak 900 for 8m, want <1% 429s and 95p latency <300ms. What min_nodes would you recommend?

Priya (Eng Runtime): rough calc: current node throughput ~120 rps/node for that model at target latency. To handle 900rps with headroom and short autoscale lag, set min_nodes=8 (maps to reserved 8 GPUs) and max_nodes=14. Also set scale_step to +4 and cooldown to 60s for campaign windows. Pre-warm: schedule model-load 2-3m before burst start via admin API: `POST /pools/{id}/prewarm?count=4`.

SRE Lead: also enable auth proxy batching for that pool to reduce auth DB thrash; this fixed similar issue for another customer. We'll run a one-off policy change and coordinate with Mirages.

Alex W: note on billing: increasing min_nodes will affect reserved capacity charges. Mike, please confirm Mirage is ok with temporary higher commit or we can propose transient burst boost (paid).

Mike (CS): pinging customer, will get signoff. Also they reported small number of 401s during spike. Any link to auth queueing?

Priya (Eng Runtime): yes, when token-service qps spikes, auth cache TTL miss coupled with primary DB saturation causes 401s. Short-term: enable auth cache priming for their tenant + increase auth service concurrency for that pool. Ops, can we flip the auth cache TTL to 60s for tenant=mirage-labs?

OpsBot: auth TTL change for tenant=mirage-labs scheduled at 2246126800.

Tara P: next steps (action items):
- Mike (CS) get customer signoff for min_nodes=8 + scale_step=4 + cooldown=60s (temporary for campaign) - Alex W to send pricing impact
- Priya to prepare prewarm API call and quick runbook for CS to trigger before campaigns
- SRE Lead to apply auth batching and coordinate rollout time
- OpsBot to monitor 429 rate and 95p latency during next window (alert threshold 429>0.5% or 95p>400ms)

Alex W: I'll draft the email with expected cost delta and keep the recommended config.

Mike (CS): thanks team. I'll update Mirage and post their signoff here. :thumbsup:

(footnote: customer logs sanitized, times are approximate)
